cases.exposure_context_quote: The patient consulted at the first level after taking approximately 25 ml of 25% paraquat with suicidal intentions
cases.agent_quote: The patient consulted at the first level after taking approximately 25 ml of 25% paraquat with suicidal intentions
cases.circumstance: Suicidal ingestion in a woman at 23.2 weeks of pregnancy with a history of three previous suicide attempts two years prior (due to sodium fluoroacetate)

symptoms.finding: several ulcers on the oral mucosa; oral and pharyngeal burns
symptoms.quote: physical examination revealed several ulcers on the oral mucosa.

symptoms.finding: caustic esophagitis Zargar 2A and erosive antrocorporal gastritis on endoscopy
symptoms.quote: The mother had oral and pharyngeal burns, so upper digestive tract endoscopy showed caustic esophagitis Zargar 2 A and erosive antrocorporal gastritis (Fig. 1).
After suspending therapy, presented acute kidney injury KDIGO 2 managed with intermittent hemodialysis on two occasions, patient recovered renal function and high-flow catheter was removed

cases.time_to_care: Gastric lavage at first-level facility; admitted to the referral hospital 30 h after ingestion (34 h to hemoadsorption start)

labs.name: vital signs at admission
labs.value: BP 116/72 mmHg, HR 75 bpm, RR 18/min, T 36°C, SpO2 95% FiO2 21%
labs.quote: She was admitted to the hospital 30 h later because of transportation difficulties, with the following vital signs: blood pressure, 116/72 mmHg; heart rate, 75 beats per minute; respiratory rate, 18 breaths per minute; temperature, 36 °C; oxygen saturation, 95% FiO2, 21%

labs.name: hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypophosphatemia
labs.value: present (values UNVERIFIED; detailed values in Table 1 not in source text)
labs.quote: The patient presented with hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, and hypophosphatemia that required replacement during his stay in the intensive care unit

treatment.name: gastric lavage with saline solution and activated charcoal
treatment.quote: gastric lavage was performed with saline solution and activated charcoal and she was referred to our institution.

treatment.name: methylprednisolone 1 g every 24 h for first three days
treatment.quote: The patient was treated according to the institutional protocol [1], which involved administering methylprednisolone 1 g every 24 h during the first three days.

treatment.name: cyclophosphamide 900 mg/day on days 2-3
treatment.quote: A medical meeting was held to assess the risk/benefit and it was determined to start cyclophosphamide 900 mg/day during the second and third days of hospitalization.

treatment.name: hemoadsorption (HA-230 cartridge, 6 h) started 34 h after intoxication, then CVVHD for 120 h
treatment.quote: 34 h after paraquat intoxication, Hemoadsroption was performed with a Jafron HA-230 cartridge for six hours and continuous venovenous hemodiafiltration (CVVHD) was continued for 120 h, requiring three oXiris filters and one ST-150 filter

treatment.name: intermittent hemodialysis (two occasions) for AKI KDIGO 2
treatment.quote: After suspending therapy, presented acute kidney injury KDIGO 2 managed with intermittent hemodialysis on two occasions, patient recovered renal function and high-flow catheter was removed

treatment.name: ascorbic acid, n-acetylcysteine, vitamin E for 21 days; parenteral nutrition 15 days; betamethasone for lung maturation
treatment.quote: management continued according to the institutional protocol with ascorbic acid, n-acetylcysteine, and vitamin E for 21 days in gynecology rooms.

cases.icu_admission: Yes ("She was transferred to the intensive care unit (ICU) with an APACHE II score of 7 points.")
cases.outcome: survived; discharged after 26 days; pregnancy ended at term without complications in another institution and the newborn was healthy
cases.outcome_quote: She reported that her pregnancy ended without complications in another institution and three weeks postpartum, the newborn was healthy, she has a psychiatric follow-up.
cases.notes: Paraquat blood/urine concentration not obtained; toxicity verified through photographs of the bottle.
